goal: Provide three independent, local-only evidence lanes for the confirmed Refine Design stage: freeze the video source contract, adapt AutoAds candidate research into AnimationHypothesisCandidate, and map bounded scene beats to Anime.js evidence and acceptance constraints. Return evidence artifacts for parent synthesis; do not publish research findings or implement animation.
context: The parent is executing a ten-stage Refine run under research/2026-08-04-ontology-video-voice-provider-research/development/refinement-runs/20260805-autoresearch-animejs-animation/. AutoAds is a non-executed design precedent, the Anime.js vault is an implemented read-only consultation core without runtime Anime.js proof, and the existing 12:30 video package is source-owned. All agents are read-only and return receipts; the parent writes the refinement artifacts and remains final approver.
anti_bias_global: Source fidelity, candidate-learning generality, and feasible motion design must disagree explicitly so no lane can silently turn a documented claim into implemented animation, or an attractive motion into semantic authority.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 freezes source-owned claims and timing while agent 1 generalizes AutoAds candidate-learning semantics on the methodology and source-corpus axes; source conservatism exposes abstractions that lose beat-level authority, while the adapter exposes source descriptions that cannot support a reusable research loop.

Agent 0 protects semantic and timing boundaries while agent 2 tests feasible Anime.js motion and browser acceptance on the methodology and source-corpus axes; source fidelity rejects decorative motion that changes meaning, while motion feasibility exposes picture-score instructions that lack separable layers or executable primitives.

Agent 1 designs governed animation hypotheses while agent 2 maps them to exact Anime.js evidence and falsifiable browser witnesses on the methodology and source-corpus axes; candidate generality is rejected when it cannot be tested, while implementation convenience is rejected when it skips contradiction, evidence, reduced-motion, or owner-review fields.
